stepBody: See image. Only type what is in the blank, do not include what is provided. Do not use spaces unless absolutely necessary. Please use double quotes (" "), instead of single quotes (' '). If you are utilizing the table, please use the numbers in order.##figure20.gif##

figureAlts.figure20.gif: The image shows a directive to create an array called differences, where each value represents how many steps the hare finished ahead of the tortoise in a race. It then instructs to write a line of code to calculate the observed p-value of the hypothesis test. Finally, it asks to describe conclusions based on a 5% p-value cutoff. The code block has two lines with blanks: differences equals Blank 1, and p_value equals Blank 2.
